announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Seattle, Washington, is awarded a not-to-exceed $213,000,000 modification (P00010) to a cost-plus-fixed-fee undefinitized contract (N0001924C0025). This modification adds scope to procure non-recurring engineering to support reconfiguration of four P-8A Multi-mission Maritime aircraft previously procured by a Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customer. This effort will modify the aircraft configuration to meet the customer's specific operational requirements. Work will be performed in Seattle, Washington (91%) and Huntington Beach, California (9%) and is expected to be completed by December 2031. FMS customer funds in the amount of $74,895,757 will be obligated at the time of award. This contract was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Compass Systems Inc.,* Johnstown, Pennsylvania, is awarded a $49,896,823 cost-plus-fixed-fee order (N6833526F1132) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N6833526G1010). This is a Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) Phase III effort for Topic N201-015 entitled, "Autonomous and Intelligent Aircraft Maintenance Technologies" derived from the Phase I and II efforts and is to transition proven Phase II technologies from prototype demonstration to operational deployment across multiple Fleet Readiness Centers (FRC). The work remains within the original SBIR scope automation, digital enablement of depot-level maintenance processes, immersive Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality training and aims to achieve fleet-wide implementation and sustainment. The Phase III effort will perform applied research and development, engineering integration, and technology transition tasks necessary to mature, deploy, and sustain advanced manufacturing and digital technologies across the FRC enterprise. Work will be performed in Johnstown, Pennsylvania (80%); and Patuxent River, Maryland (20%), and is expected to be completed in July 2031. Fiscal 2026 working capital (Defense) funds in the amount of $450,000; fiscal 2025 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $9,910,000; and fiscal 2025 Next Generation and Research, Exploration, and Development funds in the amount of $600,000, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract was competed with one offer received. Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Lakehurst, New Jersey, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Melbourne, Florida, is awarded a $21,081,363 cost-plus-fixed-fee and firm-fixed-price order (N0001926F1043) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001925G0003). This order procures non-recurring engineering, including software development, modifications to the E-2D Avionics Flight Management Computer, systems engineering, integration, and test activities, to integrate the Second Generation Anti-jam Tactical Ultra High Frequency Radio (SATURN) for NATO capability into the E-2D Advanced Hawkeye aircraft. The order also procures the production and delivery of 94 SATURN modification kits. Work will be performed in Melbourne, Florida (99.1%); West Chester, Ohio (0.6%); Ronkonkoma, New York (0.2%); and Laval, Quebec, Canada (0.1%), and is expected to be completed in April 2028. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $21,081,363 will be obligated at the time of award. This order was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
